The zero comparison contributes to condition and can be inferred through the selected res_o value, while changing it can select the wrong branch or suppress the result.
The result output reveals the predicate through whether rs1_i or zero is returned, and reset or lack of a clocked update can prevent that predicate-dependent result from being available.
valid_cmd can block use of the predicate by forcing the result assignment to the zero branch, but it neither exposes nor changes the predicate itself.
